cases.name: an unsatisfiable script
cases.purpose: unsat, with the names of the assertions in the core.

input.smtlib:
(set-option :produce-unsat-cores true)
(declare-const x Int)
(assert (! (> x 0) :named a))
(assert (! (< x 0) :named b))
(assert (! (> x 5) :named c))
(check-sat)
(get-unsat-core)
